mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.school_id, s.school_name AS school_name, c.grade_id, g.grade_name AS grade_name, c.class_name AS name, c.class_code AS code, c.sort AS class_num, c.head_teacher_id, t.teacher_name AS head_teacher_name, c.status, c.sort, '' AS remark, c.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student st WHERE st.class_id = c.id AND st.deleted = 0) AS student_count FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN school s ON c.school_id = s.id LEFT JOIN grade g ON c.grade_id = g.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.head_teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0
